summary: On April 30, 2026, Verano Holdings Corp. announced in an 8-K that its Board of Directors authorized a share repurchase of up to $20 million of its common stock listed on Cboe Canada, limited to 18,219,090 shares (5% of outstanding). Repurchases may occur over 12 months ending April 30, 2027, via open market, private transactions, or block purchases, subject to daily volume limits (25% of average daily volume) and Rule 10b-18. The repurchase is structurally flexible with a dollar cap. Watch execution cadence and impact on shareholders as the buyback runs against market liquidity.
